title: Aquarium discovery weekend
brief: The original delivery of six cartons of interpretive signs to aquarium service entrance has fallen through. The aquarium educators needs a replacement shipment in time for the weekend volunteers' briefing. This is a single, indivisible load. Team up to book a replacement service today.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text:
Hi all, Sam here on the supplier side. The six cartons of interpretive signs are packed and I'm the one who releases them. Two firm points from my end: all six have to travel together on one vehicle, and the earliest I can hand them over is 09:45. Nothing earlier is possible.

To lock in a booking today, I need a few things from you:

- **Robin:** what pickup slots do you have at 09:45 or later, and what's the transit time and quote for each?
- **Casey:** what are the receiving hours at the aquarium service entrance, and what's the latest the load can arrive and still be ready for the weekend volunteers' briefing?
- **Taylor:** what budget are we working within, so we know which of Robin's options you can approve?

Once we have a slot that fits Casey's window and Taylor's budget, I'll confirm the release time and have the cartons staged for the driver.

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text:
I can book all six cartons together. Today’s quotes, in crowns, are V331 (10:09 pickup, staffed handover by 11:07, 72), V646 (10:12, by 10:55, 62), V114 (10:15, by 11:42, 34) and V605 (09:50, by 11:18, 45).

Sam, when will all six be ready? Casey, what’s the staffed receiving window at the aquarium service entrance? Taylor, what spend can you approve? I’ll book the lowest-priced service that fits.

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text:
Hi all, Casey here at the receiving end. The key constraint from my side: I can guarantee someone at the aquarium service entrance to sign for the load, but the latest staffed handover I can accept is 11:30, and that's a hard cutoff. Arriving at 11:30 is fine, anything after is not. We can't take an unattended drop, so the cartons can't be left at the door.

Since all six cartons need to come as one load, here's what I need to make this work:

Sam, when will the cartons be ready for pickup?
Robin, what service options can get the full load to the service entrance by 11:30, and what does each cost?
Taylor, can you confirm which of those fits the budget?

Once we settle on an option, give me the expected arrival time and I'll make sure someone is at the entrance to receive it.

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text: Sam, when and where can all six cartons be picked up? Casey, what delivery window works at the aquarium service entrance before the briefing? Robin, please quote a service that keeps the cartons together and fits both windows. Include all fees and let us know how long you can hold it. I can approve up to 92 crowns all in.

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text:
I’m tendering V605 at 45 crowns all in. It takes all six cartons on one vehicle at 09:50, five minutes after Sam can release them, and guarantees staffed handover by 11:18, twelve minutes before Casey’s cutoff. It’s the lowest-priced service that meets both windows. No hold duration is confirmed.

Sam, please confirm the pickup point and 09:50 release. Casey, please confirm someone will sign at the aquarium service entrance. Taylor, please approve the 45 crowns. If anything blocks booking, please flag it now.

[PROPOSE: V605]

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text:
My release time has changed: quality control has detained the batch for relabeling, so the earliest I can now hand over the six cartons is 10:03, not 09:45. That means I can't make V605's 09:50 pickup, so I have to hold on that tender.

Of Robin's other quotes, two still work against Casey's 11:30 cutoff and Taylor's 92-crown limit:

- V646: 10:12 pickup, handover by 10:55, 62 crowns
- V331: 10:09 pickup, handover by 11:07, 72 crowns

V114 is out because it arrives at 11:42, after the cutoff.

I'd suggest V646. It's the cheaper of the two, gives me nine minutes of margin after release, and arrives well ahead of Casey's cutoff. Robin, if you re-tender V646 I can approve it and have all six cartons staged for a 10:12 pickup.

[HOLD: V605]

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text:
V605 works for the site. Handover by 11:18 is inside my 11:30 cutoff, and I'll have someone staffed at the aquarium service entrance to sign for all six cartons. Nothing has changed on my end: 11:30 remains the hard limit and we still can't take an unattended drop, so Robin, please flag immediately if the driver's arrival starts slipping past 11:18.

[APPROVE: V605]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
Robin, I authorize 45 crowns all in for V605. It’s within budget, keeps all six cartons together, and meets both the pickup and staffed handover windows.

[APPROVE: V605]

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text:
I’m requesting V646. Sam’s revised 10:03 release rules out V605. V646 picks up all six cartons together at 10:12 and guarantees staffed handover by 10:55, giving Casey 35 minutes before the cutoff. At 62 crowns all in, it’s the cheapest service that meets both times.

Please ratify V646 on this thread. Sam, confirm release for the 10:12 pickup. Casey, confirm someone will sign at the aquarium service entrance. Taylor, approve the revised 62-crown total.

[BOOK: V646]

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text:
I approve V646. My earliest release is 10:03, so the 10:12 pickup works, and all six cartons will be staged together for the driver on one vehicle. Handover by 10:55 is inside Casey's 11:30 cutoff, and 62 crowns is within Taylor's 92-crown limit.

Casey and Taylor, your earlier approvals were for V605, which I can't make; V646 needs your sign-off on the 10:55 arrival and the 62-crown total.

[APPROVE: V646]

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text:
V646 works for the site. Handover by 10:55 is well inside my 11:30 cutoff, and I'll have someone staffed at the aquarium service entrance to sign for all six cartons. My earlier approval of V605 no longer applies since Sam can't make that pickup. My constraints are unchanged: 11:30 is the hard limit and no unattended drop.

[APPROVE: V646]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
Robin, I authorize 62 crowns all in for V646. It’s within my 92-crown limit. All six cartons travel together at 10:12, after Sam’s 10:03 release, with staffed handover by 10:55, before Casey’s 11:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V646]

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text:
Hi all, Sam here on the supplier side. The six cartons of signs are packed and ready, and I'm the one who releases them. Two things to plan around: the earliest pickup I can commit to is 09:45 today, nothing sooner, and all six cartons have to go together on one vehicle, no splitting.

Robin, what collection slots do you have from 09:45 onward, and what would the arrival time at the aquarium service entrance be for each? Casey, what hours can you receive at the service entrance? Taylor, if you can share what budget we need to stay within, we can pick the option that fits and I'll confirm the release straight away.

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text:
Morning all. I can tender and book the replacement today, and I have four all-in options for the six cartons as a single load:

- V605: pickup 09:50, staffed handover guaranteed by 11:18, 45 crowns
- V331: pickup 10:09, handover by 11:07, 72 crowns
- V646: pickup 10:12, handover by 10:55, 62 crowns
- V114: pickup 10:15, handover by 11:42, 34 crowns

Departure times are fixed, so I need three things to pick the right one:

Sam, what's the earliest the cartons can be packed and ready at your dock? That decides whether the 09:50 pickup is even possible.

Casey, what's the latest you can take a staffed handover at the service entrance, and are there any windows when nobody's there to receive?

Taylor, what's the budget ceiling for this?

V114 is cheapest if the 10:15 pickup and 11:42 handover work for everyone, so that's my default unless the timings or budget rule it out. As soon as I have your answers I'll book.

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text: I can receive all six cartons together at the aquarium service entrance by 11:30, including 11:30 itself. Someone must hand them to me in person. Sam, when will the cartons be ready? Robin, can you quote a service that guarantees that handover? Taylor, can you confirm the budget?

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text: I can approve up to 92 crowns all in for all six cartons traveling together. Sam, when and where can Robin collect them? Casey, what delivery window works at the aquarium service entrance before the briefing? Robin, please quote a service we can book today with pickup and delivery times that fit. I’ll confirm approval here.

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text:
Thanks all, that settles it. My default V114 is out: its 11:42 handover misses Casey's 11:30 cutoff. The other three all fit Sam's 09:45 release, Casey's 11:30 deadline, and Taylor's 92-crown ceiling.

I'm tendering V605: pickup 09:50, staffed in-person handover guaranteed by 11:18, 45 crowns all in, with all six cartons on one vehicle.

The tradeoff is that V605 is the cheapest fit by 17 crowns but has the tightest timings. Pickup is five minutes after Sam's earliest release, and the handover guarantee leaves 12 minutes before Casey's cutoff. If anyone wants more margin, V646 (pickup 10:12, handover by 10:55, 62 crowns) is the fallback.

To book V605 I need each of you to commit or raise a concrete objection:

- **Sam:** can you have all six cartons at the dock for a 09:50 collection?
- **Casey:** can you be at the service entrance in person for a handover up to 11:18?
- **Taylor:** do you approve 45 crowns?

[PROPOSE: V605]

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text:
I can't approve V605: a change on my side just ruled it out. Quality control has detained the batch for relabeling, so my earliest release is now 10:03, not 09:45. I can't load anything before then, which means the 09:50 pickup is impossible.

That also changes the fallback picture. From Robin's list, the options with pickup at or after 10:03 are V331 (10:09, handover by 11:07, 72 crowns), V646 (10:12, handover by 10:55, 62 crowns) and V114, which is already out on Casey's 11:30 cutoff.

I'd suggest V646: pickup at 10:12 gives me nine minutes of margin after release, the 10:55 handover is well inside Casey's 11:30 deadline, and 62 crowns is under Taylor's 92 ceiling and cheaper than V331. I can commit to having all six cartons at the dock together for a 10:12 collection.

Robin, can you re-tender on V646? Casey and Taylor, does that work for you?

[HOLD: V605]

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text:
I’ll be at the aquarium service entrance to receive all six cartons in person. V605’s guaranteed handover by 11:18 is within my 11:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V605]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
I approve 45 crowns all in for V605. It’s within budget, keeps all six cartons together, and guarantees an in-person handover by 11:18, before Casey’s 11:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V605]

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text:
V605 is off: Sam's release has moved to 10:03 after the relabeling hold, so a 09:50 pickup can't be loaded. Casey and Taylor, your approvals were for V605 and don't carry over, so I need fresh ones.

I'm requesting V646: pickup 10:12, staffed in-person handover guaranteed by 10:55, 62 crowns all in, with all six cartons on one vehicle.

Why V646:

- **Pickup:** 10:12 is nine minutes after Sam's 10:03 release, and Sam has already committed to having the cartons at the dock for it.
- **Handover:** 10:55 is 35 minutes inside Casey's 11:30 cutoff.
- **Price:** 62 crowns is under Taylor's 92 ceiling and 10 cheaper than V331, the only other service that still fits.

V114 remains out because its 11:42 handover misses Casey's cutoff.

The cost of the change is 17 crowns more than V605, in exchange for a pickup Sam can actually make and an earlier handover.

To release this I need all three of you to ratify V646:

- **Sam:** confirm the 10:03 release is firm and all six cartons will be at the dock for 10:12.
- **Casey:** confirm you'll be at the service entrance in person for a handover up to 10:55.
- **Taylor:** confirm approval of 62 crowns.

[BOOK: V646]

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text:
I approve V646. My release at 10:03 is firm following the relabeling hold, and all six cartons will be at the dock together for the 10:12 collection, loaded as a single load on one vehicle. The 10:55 handover sits inside Casey's 11:30 cutoff and 62 crowns is within Taylor's 92 ceiling, so it fits everything I know of.

[APPROVE: V646]

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text:
I’ll receive all six cartons in person at the aquarium service entrance. V646 guarantees handover by 10:55, before my 11:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V646]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
I authorize 62 crowns all in for V646. That’s within my 92-crown limit and covers all six cartons on one vehicle.

[APPROVE: V646]
